## Description

Revoke with reason (lost/stolen/retired): binding revoked, keys/tokens invalidated, queued audio on the device becomes unreadable, audit event and admin notification.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** After revoke, the device cannot authenticate or upload within 60 seconds (exit gate 3 test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Revocation is audited and the admin notified.
- [ ] **AC3.** A revoked device must be re-provisioned to be used again.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
